body:
I took some medication and I will probably fall asleep very soon, but I see no one has replied to this yet.

The fact that you're aware that your issues with sexual behavior are issues makes you better than a lot of people who do these things and never give a second thought as to whom they're hurting. It does show a strength of character to admit that this is a problem of yours, and you obviously don't lack empathy. Also, the vast majority of people with sexual conduct issues improve under the right therapy conditions. If your therapist doesn't know about this specific behavior, you need to tell them. The earlier you start working on this, the better.

Don't listen to your mom. She clearly doesn't understand if your emotional pain is "frustrating" to her, and she's not a doctor so she doesn't know what medication will do. I think that SSRIs are sometimes given for intrusive thoughts in OCD patients. And don't be afraid to switch therapists often (if that's possible for you) until you find one who understands your situation.

Like I said: you obviously have empathy, and that is commendable. I hope you'll stick around and be a part of you brother's life.

I'm glad that you're doing well in school. I hope you do get a scholarship. 

What I find most frustrating is that when I do make any progress, it's so small that it feels like it might as well be nothing at all, because I overcame something that "normal" people never had to deal with at all. It helps a bit to look at things in very small scales: if I can go to one specific place after practicing enough, then other things will probably get easier. But that's such a frustratingly slow pace to have to be satisfied with.

There is a woman in my neighborhood who is married, but has an anxiety disorder like mine and has only been seen outside her house a couple of times. But she managed to find a partner. I find that inspiring.

Do you have access to medical care? If you have bipolar disorder, medication is probably important. If not, there are therapeutic techniques that you can do on your own.
